title: PH61003: Physics For Medicine And Biology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Motion: SHM - free, damped, forced, coupled oscillator, superposition, random
motion, diffusion in 1,2,3-dimension, cellular diffusion, clinical
applications, conservation laws, Bernoulli’s theorem ,transport of fluid,
Poiseuille flow. Waves : Acoustic wave ,wave equation, wave at interface and
inside medium, generation, divergence of beam, principle of ultrasonic
scanning, Elements of electromagnetism, Electromagnetic wave, waves in
dielectric and conducting media, Laser, Fiber optics, Polarization. Matter
Wave: wave –particle duality, Photon, Radiation from hot bodies, energy
quantization in 1-d system, energy levels in atoms and molecules. Statistical
Mechanics: macro- and micro- states, entropy, partition function, MaxwellBoltzmann statistics, chemical reaction. Examples from biology and medicine to
be discussed throughout the course.
